dogecoin.text:
8/8 Dogecoin’s story isn’t just about a coin; it’s about human nature. 

Hype, FOMO, greed, and dreams of striking it rich. 

But remember: memes may be entertaining, but they’re not a financial plan.

6/8 But here’s where dreams turn to nightmares. As 

Dogecoin climbed, whales (big investors) quietly sold. 

When the price began to dip, panic set in. 

The crash came hard and fast. 

$DOGE plummeted, leaving countless small investors with losses. 📉💔 https://t.co/xQKW5dW24w

5/8 Hype snowballs. 

Celebrities jump in—Snoop Dogg, Mark Cuban, even Gene Simmons of KISS. 

Retail investors, hungry for the next big thing, flood in. 

By May 2021, Dogecoin soars to $0.73. People are chanting: “TO THE MOON!” 🌕🚀 https://t.co/KMWLwkzJ1k

4/8 Fast forward to 2020. Enter: Elon Musk. 

The world’s richest meme lord starts tweeting about $DOGE. “One word: Doge” sends shockwaves through the crypto world. 

Suddenly, a joke coin is a cultural phenomenon. Musk crowns it: “The people’s crypto.” 💎 https://t.co/OCczLE5MMc

3/8 In the early days, Dogecoin was a feel-good movement. 

The community raised funds to send the Jamaican bobsled team to the Olympics and sponsored a NASCAR driver. 

It wasn’t about profits—it was about fun. But things took a turn. 🛷🏁

1/8 🐶💰 Let’s rewind to the wildest chapter in the crypto world and its not $TRUMP: 

IT'S #Dogecoin—the original meme coin that went from a joke to a global obsession. 🚀 

A story of hype, hope, betrayal, and memes. Buckle up.🧵👇 https://t.co/KwbmmLfKVl
